cases.sentence: ___ из кранов умывальников текла совсем не теплая, а родниковая, обжигающе ледяная, аж зубы сводила.
cases.translation: The water from the washstand taps was not warm at all, but spring-cold, scaldingly icy, enough to set your teeth on edge.
cases.explain: «Вода» is the grammatical subject of «текла» (flowed), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Возле ___ висела большая отрядная стенгазета, посвященная открытию смены и первому лагерному дню.
cases.translation: Next to the door hung the detachment's big wall newspaper, dedicated to the opening of the shift and the first camp day.
cases.explain: The preposition «возле» (next to) governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Уберите непригодные в кладовые, а к тихому ___ я кого-нибудь попрошу принести в отряд новые.
cases.translation: Take the unusable ones to the storeroom, and by quiet hour I'll ask someone to bring new ones to the detachment.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (by/toward a point in time) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Пойду спрошу ___, откуда у них сирень.
cases.translation: I'll go ask the girls where they got the lilac.
cases.explain: «Девочек» is the direct object of the transitive verb «спрошу» (I'll ask); for animate plural nouns the accusative matches the genitive form.

cases.sentence: Юрка выдохнул и с безмерной ___ взглянул на Володю.
cases.translation: Yurka exhaled and looked at Volodya with immense gratitude.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» meaning "with" (manner) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Проверьте с ним в детском ___ матрасы.
cases.translation: Check the mattresses with him in the children's cabin.
cases.explain: «В» expressing static location governs the prepositional case.

reading.ru: Утро в ласточке Юрка любил особенно сильно.
reading.question: How did Yurka feel about mornings at Lastochka?
options: He loved them especially, except for getting out from under the warm blanket
reading.correct: He loved them especially, except for getting out from under the warm blanket
reading.explain: The text says he loved the mornings especially, but only until he had to crawl out from under the warm blanket.

reading.ru: Но потом по внутренней радиолинии запускали пластинку с сигналом «Подъем».
reading.question: What signal came over the camp's internal radio line?
options: A record with the "Wake Up" (Подъем) signal
reading.correct: A record with the "Wake Up" (Подъем) signal
reading.explain: The text describes a record with the "Podyom" (Wake Up) signal being played over the internal radio line.

reading.ru: «В последний раз спрашиваю, зачем ты вчера обломал кусты сирени, а?»
reading.question: What did Ira Petrovna angrily ask Yurka about?
options: Why he broke the lilac bushes yesterday
Why he was late for breakfast
reading.correct: Why he broke the lilac bushes yesterday
reading.explain: Ira demands to know why he broke the lilac bushes yesterday.

reading.ru: «Ирина, это правда был не он», — раздался голос за спиной.
reading.question: Who spoke up from behind to defend Yurka?
reading.correct: Volodya
reading.explain: A voice from behind says it truly wasn't him, and Yurka turns to see Volodya.

reading.ru: Сашка шлепнулся со сцены, Юра вызвался помочь».
reading.question: What excuse did Volodya give for Yura's whereabouts the previous evening?
options: Sashka fell off the stage and Yura volunteered to help
Yura was sick in the infirmary
reading.correct: Sashka fell off the stage and Yura volunteered to help
reading.explain: Volodya explains that Sashka fell off the stage and Yura volunteered to help carry him to the infirmary.

reading.ru: Сбоку стен газеты было нарисовано здоровенное дерево, яблоню, а под ней Юрка висел вверх тормашками, привязанные за лодыжку гирлянда и к ветке, руки-ноги в стороны.
reading.question: What did the wall newspaper caricature show?
options: Yurka hanging upside down from the apple tree, tangled in a garland
reading.correct: Yurka hanging upside down from the apple tree, tangled in a garland
reading.explain: The caricature drew a huge apple tree with Yurka hanging upside down from it, tied by the ankle with the garland.

reading.ru: И Юрка до того, как отправиться таскать матрасы, узнал у актива отряда имя художника — Ксюша.
reading.question: Whose name did Yurka learn as the artist of the humiliating caricature?
reading.correct: Ksyusha's
reading.explain: Before going to carry mattresses, Yurka found out from the detachment activists that the artist was Ksyusha.

reading.ru: Шесть обнаруженных матрасов парни вынесли и свалили рядом с корпусом.
reading.question: What did the two boys do with the six mattresses they found?
options: Carried them out and piled them next to the building
reading.correct: Carried them out and piled them next to the building
reading.explain: The text says the boys carried the six mattresses out and dumped them next to the building.

reading.ru: Ловко взобравшись наверх, даже лестница не понадобилась Юрка, в три счета обнаружил проблему.
reading.question: How did Yurka get onto the roof to find the leak?
options: He climbed up nimbly without even needing a ladder
He couldn't get up at all
reading.correct: He climbed up nimbly without even needing a ladder
reading.explain: The text says he climbed up nimbly, not even needing a ladder, and found the problem in no time.

reading.ru: Пятый отряд, во главе с обоими вожатыми, держал путь на речку.
reading.question: Where was the fifth detachment headed, led by both counselors?
reading.correct: To the river
reading.explain: The text says the fifth detachment, led by both counselors, was heading to the river.

reading.ru: Вы не знали, что эта территория в войну была оккупирована немцами?
reading.question: What excuse did Yurka invent on the spot for being on the roof?
options: That he was watching out for treasure hunters, since the area was occupied by Germans during the war
That he was fixing the roof for money
That he was hiding from Ira
That he was looking for his cat
reading.correct: That he was watching out for treasure hunters, since the area was occupied by Germans during the war
reading.explain: Yurka improvises, claiming to be watching for treasure hunters since the area was occupied by Germans during the war.

reading.ru: Юра увидел, как перепуганная, но грозная Ира Петровна несется к нему по земляной тропинке, поднимая облака пыли.
reading.question: How did Ira Petrovna approach Yurka on the roof?
options: Frightened but fierce, running toward him down the dirt path, raising clouds of dust
reading.correct: Frightened but fierce, running toward him down the dirt path, raising clouds of dust
reading.explain: The text describes Ira as frightened yet fierce, racing toward him along the dirt path and kicking up clouds of dust.

reading.ru: Присел и все-таки прыгнул.
reading.question: What did Yurka finally do to get down from the roof?
options: He climbed down the ladder carefully
reading.correct: He crouched and jumped down
reading.explain: The text simply states he crouched and jumped after all.

reading.ru: На желтом песке двумя ровными рядочками разместилось 20 пар детской обуви.
reading.question: How were the children's shoes arranged on the yellow sand?
options: In two neat rows, twenty pairs
reading.correct: In two neat rows, twenty pairs
reading.explain: The text describes twenty pairs of children's shoes arranged in two even rows on the yellow sand.

reading.ru: Тот стоял по щиколотку в воде и сосредоточенно смотрел на вверенных ему малышей.
reading.question: How deep in the water did Volodya stand while watching the children?
options: He stood on the shore, not in the water
reading.correct: Ankle-deep
reading.explain: The text says he stood ankle-deep in the water, watching intently over the children entrusted to him.

reading.ru: «Пчелкин, прекрати брызгаться!»
reading.question: What did Volodya order Pchyolkin to stop doing?
reading.correct: Splashing water
reading.explain: Volodya orders Pchyolkin to stop splashing.

reading.ru: У Ваньки была необычная колода на пятьдесят четыре карты.
reading.question: What was unusual about Vanka's deck of cards?
reading.correct: It had fifty-four cards
reading.explain: The text notes that Vanka's deck was unusual, having fifty-four cards.

reading.ru: Со всей дури Миха ударил лбом в песок и заорал на весь пляж.
reading.question: What did Mikha do as his "punishment" from losing the card game?
options: He hit his forehead in the sand and shouted across the beach
He had to buy everyone ice cream
He had to sing a song
He had to swim across the river
reading.correct: He hit his forehead in the sand and shouted across the beach
reading.explain: The text says Mikha slammed his forehead into the sand with all his might and yelled across the whole beach.

reading.ru: «Пустите меня в шахту!»
reading.question: What phrase did Mikha shout repeatedly while performing his punishment?
options: "Let me into the mine!" (Пустите меня в шахту!)
reading.correct: "Let me into the mine!" (Пустите меня в шахту!)
reading.explain: Mikha repeatedly shouts "Пустите меня в шахту!" (Let me into the mine!).

reading.ru: И именно в этот момент физрук засвистел в свисток, а из воды донеслось паническое «Спасите!».
reading.question: What alarming cry came from the water, prompting the coach to blow his whistle?
reading.correct: "Help!" (Спасите!)
reading.explain: The text says a panicked cry of "Спасите!" (Help!) came from the water just as the coach blew his whistle.

reading.ru: Они вдвоем-таки вытащили мальчишку из воды, схватив заплавки.
reading.question: How did Yura and Volodya get Pchyolkin out of the water?
options: They grabbed his swim trunks and pulled him out together
reading.correct: They grabbed his swim trunks and pulled him out together
reading.explain: The text says the two of them together pulled the boy out of the water, grabbing his swim trunks.

reading.ru: У Олежки голос громкий, и реплики он запоминал быстро, и в роль вживался отлично, да только картавил так, что половину слов было не разобрать.
reading.question: What was Olezhka's acting problem, despite his loud voice and quick memorization?
options: He rolled his R's so much that half his words were unclear
He was too shy to perform
reading.correct: He rolled his R's so much that half his words were unclear
reading.explain: The text says Olezhka had a loud voice and learned lines fast, but his speech impediment made half his words unintelligible.

reading.ru: Она фоном бренчала на пианино всю ту же надоевшую лунную сонату.
reading.question: What piece did Masha keep playing badly in the background during rehearsal?
reading.correct: The same tired "Moonlight Sonata"
reading.explain: The text says she strummed the same tiresome Moonlight Sonata in the background.

reading.ru: «Чтобы Ксюша меня поцеловала.
reading.question: What did Yurka demand from the trio in exchange for trying to lure Volodya to the disco?
options: That Ksyusha kiss him on the cheek twice, in front of everyone
Their silence about the lilac bushes
reading.correct: That Ksyusha kiss him on the cheek twice, in front of everyone
reading.explain: Yurka demands that Ksyusha kiss him on the cheek, twice, in front of everyone.

reading.ru: Сразу после ужина, выйдя из столовой, он направился к детским корпусам приглашать Валою.
reading.question: Where did Yurka head right after dinner?
options: To the children's cabins to invite Volodya
reading.correct: To the children's cabins to invite Volodya
reading.explain: The text says right after dinner, leaving the dining hall, he headed to the children's cabins to go invite Volodya.
